scoring.title: How scoring works
scoring.formula: Score: {base, number}; −{time_penalty, number} per {seconds_per_point, number} s; −{hint_penalty, number} per hint; −{reset_penalty, number} per Reset bay; minimum {minimum, number}.
scoring.best: Your best: {score, number} points ({seconds, number} s, {hints, number} hints).
scoring.best_rule: A replay replaces your best result only when its score is higher. Its time and hint count are saved together.
scoring.preparing: Score starts when the bay is ready
scoring.breakdown: Base {base, number} − time {time, number} − hints {hints, number} − Reset bay {resets, number}; final score: {score, number}.
scoring.floor: The minimum of {minimum, number} points applies (+{adjustment, number} after deductions).
scoring.improved: New best: {score, number}; previous best: {previous, number}.
scoring.kept: Previous best kept: {previous, number}. This attempt: {score, number}.
scoring.previous_unknown: This historical attempt has no saved comparison with its previous best.
scoring.exam: Incident drill results are separate and do not replace your map best. Hints are disabled during an incident drill.
scoring.hinted: “With hints” means at least one hint was revealed in the attempt or transferred from its briefing. The map filter describes the stored best result.
scoring.briefing_rule: Passed levels: briefing hints are free. Unpassed levels: confirm before the first reveal; hints carry into the next Run once, including free choice. After Run, reading again requires confirmation. Hints cannot be newly revealed on an unpassed briefing while your bay is active.
scoring.achievements: Achievements: No hints; No reset; Under {minutes, number} minutes. Time is counted after preparation; Reset bay starts a new timer and retains hint deductions plus the reset deduction.

lab.intro: Choose a workspace, open a Guide and try its examples. Labs have no score or quest timer.
lab.persistence: Files, infrastructure and volumes are saved until you delete or reset the Lab. Stop releases the shared compute slot; running processes and open terminals are not preserved. Training Bay and Lab share one running environment.
lab.confirm.reset: Reset this entire Lab? All its files, infrastructure and volumes will be deleted and recreated.
lab.confirm.delete: Permanently delete this Lab and all its files, infrastructure and volumes?
lab.files_help: The workspace is ~/lab. Each example has run.sh, check.sh and cleanup.sh. Read the Guide, predict the result, then run the example. Cleanup affects only the objects named by that example.
lab.status.preparing: Preparing · this can take a few minutes
error.lab_busy: The shared environment is busy. Stop the active Training Bay or Lab before starting another.
error.lab_missing: This Lab does not exist or does not belong to this account.
error.lab_working: A Lab operation is already in progress.
error.lab_confirm: Confirm deletion of this Lab’s saved data.
error.lab_version: This saved Lab uses a different profile version. Keep it for recovery, or explicitly delete it before creating a new version.
error.lab_operation: The operation failed. Saved work was retained. Try Stop, or reset explicitly to rebuild; contact the administrator if capacity remains occupied.
error.lab_unavailable: Labs are unavailable in this installation.
error.lab_inactive: Start this Lab before opening its terminal.
guide.full_lab: The complete Lab files adapt the original experiments to this private workspace. Run them separately from the short introduction; each folder keeps the actual configuration and checks beside it.
